description:
**Phase F — Branch summarization. Deps: F1, C3.**

Port `prepareBranchEntries` from `tmp/pi-mono/.../compaction/branch-summarization.ts:185-237`.

**Two-pass design** (this is the key difference from auto-compaction):
1. Scan ALL entries for `branch_summary` and `compaction` types where `from_hook? != true`; pull `details.{read_files, modified_files}` into `file_ops` (cumulative file tracking even if old context exceeds budget).
2. Walk newest→oldest adding messages until `token_budget`; also extract `file_ops` from assistant messages. Summary entries get special treatment: include even if over budget when `total_tokens < 0.9 × token_budget`.

Returns `%BranchPreparation{messages, file_ops, total_tokens}`.

Tests: cumulative-file-ops case across nested summaries; budget-overflow case.
title: F2. prepare_branch_entries/2 (two-pass)
